about: Reference shapes collected while reading open-source notch apps and the official Claude Code hooks reference. None of these were captured from a live agent; treat them as encoder test targets. Payloads and decisions captured live on this machine (Claude Code 2.1.296) are in Fixtures/claude/ and take precedence wherever the two differ.

claude-permissionrequest-input-doc.json.origin: DOC https://code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks (PermissionRequest input). Paths shortened. Note: no tool_use_id.

claude-permissionrequest-allow.json.origin: SRC farouqaldori/vibe-notch ClaudeIsland/Resources/claude-island-state.py and wxtsky/CodeIsland Sources/CodeIsland/AppState.swift (approvePermission). Matches DOC.

claude-permissionrequest-deny.json.origin: SRC wxtsky/CodeIsland Sources/CodeIsland/AppState.swift (denyPermission). No message field.

claude-permissionrequest-deny-with-messa.origin: SRC farouqaldori/vibe-notch ClaudeIsland/Resources/claude-island-state.py. DOC: message tells Claude why; optional interrupt:true stops Claude.

claude-permissionrequest-always-session-.origin: SRC wxtsky/CodeIsland Sources/CodeIsland/AppState.swift (approvePermission always:true). Builds its own rule; ignores permission_suggestions. ruleContent "*" is CodeIsland's choice; DOC says omit ruleContent to match the whole tool.

claude-permissionrequest-always-mcp-code.origin: SRC wxtsky/CodeIsland AppState.swift, fix for issue #224: MCP tools must not carry ruleContent.

claude-permissionrequest-always-from-sug.origin: Constructed from DOC: echo one entry of the input's permission_suggestions back as decision.updatedPermissions. Neither open-source app does this.

claude-askuserquestion-via-permissionreq.origin: SRC wxtsky/CodeIsland AppState.swift (askUserQuestionUpdatedInput). Includes CodeIsland's extra scalar "answer" key, which is not in the documented AskUserQuestion schema.
Same as above without the undocumented "answer" key. Answers are keyed by the question text; multi-select joins labels with commas (DOC).

claude-askuserquestion-via-pretooluse-do.origin: DOC https://code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks (PreToolUse, tools that require user interaction).

terminal-app-jump.applescript.origin: Written for Perch. Technique from wxtsky/CodeIsland Sources/CodeIsland/TerminalActivator.swift (activateTerminalApp); terms validated against the local Terminal.sdef and compiled with osacompile. Not executed.

terminal-app-frontmost-tty.applescript.origin: Written for Perch. Technique from wxtsky/CodeIsland Sources/CodeIsland/TerminalVisibilityDetector.swift (isTerminalAppTabActive). Compiled, not executed.
